judgement.reason: The outcome DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is at least as strict as this single-image PDF web app warrants.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: the start script scripts/init-without-ocr.sh runs 6 long-running servers in the background (), create_office_profile_template, start_unoserver_demand_manager, env -u) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The shown lines of the start script do not prove that the background servers (such as the unoserver manager) are optional or absent on the production path, so the multi-process finding cannot be dismissed.
